name: CakeSplit — On-Chain Split Bill
description: Trustless group split-bill covenant on Bitcoin Cash. Friends chip into one locked pot that only pays the merchant once full, and blocks organizer cancellation once funded.

organizer.name: Organizer
organizer.description: Creates the split bill, locks the merchant destination and target amount, and can cancel only before the pot is full.

contributor.name: Contributor
contributor.description: A group member contributing their share into the Bill Pot covenant.

settler.name: Settler
settler.description: Any participant or merchant triggering permissionless settlement once the pot reaches the target.

openBill.name: Open Split Bill
openBill.description: Create a new Bill Pot covenant locked to the merchant address and target payout, seeded with the initial deposit.

organizer.name: Open Split Bill
organizer.description: Generate the organizer key and deposit the initial share into the Bill Pot.

chipIn.name: Chip In Share
chipIn.description: Add a contributor's share to the existing Bill Pot while preserving the exact covenant locking script.

contributor.name: Chip In Share
contributor.description: Contribute satoshis to increase the Bill Pot balance.

settleBill.name: Settle & Pay Merchant
settleBill.description: Permissionlessly pay the locked merchant address once the Bill Pot holds the full payout plus settlement fee buffer.

settler.name: Settle & Pay Merchant
settler.description: Broadcast the signature-free settlement payout to the merchant.

cancelBill.name: Cancel & Refund Bill
cancelBill.description: Organizer-only escape hatch to cancel an incomplete bill and reclaim funds before the pot reaches full funding.

organizer.name: Cancel & Refund Bill
organizer.description: Sign with the organizer key to refund the pot before the bill target is reached.

openBillTransaction.name: Split Bill Opened
openBillTransaction.description: Opened a CakeSplit Bill Pot with $(<initialDepositSatoshis>) satoshis toward a $(<merchantPayoutSatoshis>) satoshi bill.

chipInTransaction.name: Share Contributed
chipInTransaction.description: Added $(<contributionSatoshis>) satoshis to the CakeSplit Bill Pot.

settleBillTransaction.name: Bill Settled to Merchant
settleBillTransaction.description: Paid $(<merchantPayoutSatoshis>) satoshis directly to the locked merchant address.

cancelBillTransaction.name: Split Bill Cancelled
cancelBillTransaction.description: Organizer cancelled an incomplete CakeSplit Bill Pot and refunded funds.

chipInPotInput.name: Current Bill Pot
chipInPotInput.description: Spends the active Bill Pot UTXO via the permissionless chipIn branch.

settlePotInput.name: Funded Bill Pot
settlePotInput.description: Spends the funded Bill Pot UTXO via the permissionless settleBill branch.

cancelPotInput.name: Incomplete Bill Pot
cancelPotInput.description: Spends an underfunded Bill Pot UTXO with the organizer signature.

openPotOutput.name: Bill Pot
openPotOutput.description: Initial CakeSplit Bill Pot output locked to the split-bill covenant.

updatedPotOutput.name: Updated Bill Pot
updatedPotOutput.description: Bill Pot output carrying the previous balance plus the new contribution.

merchantPayoutOutput.name: Merchant Payout
merchantPayoutOutput.description: Final bill settlement paid directly to the merchant.

refundOutput.name: Organizer Refund
refundOutput.description: Returned satoshis after cancelling an incomplete bill.

billPotLockingScript.name: CakeSplit Bill Pot Covenant
billPotLockingScript.description: P2SH32 covenant enforcing monotonic contributions, locked merchant payout, and pre-full-only organizer cancel.

scripts.billPotRedeemScript: <billNonce> OP_DROP OP_DUP OP_0 OP_NUMEQUAL OP_IF OP_DROP enforceSameCovenant enforcePotGrows OP_ELSE OP_1 OP_NUMEQUAL OP_IF enforceMerchantDestination enforceMerchantAmount OP_ELSE enforceNotYetFull <organizerPublicKey> OP_CHECKSIG OP_ENDIF OP_ENDIF

settlementFeeSatoshis.name: Settlement Fee Buffer
settlementFeeSatoshis.description: Fixed satoshi reserve so permissionless settlement pays its own network fee without extra inputs.

billNonce.name: Bill Nonce
billNonce.description: Unique byte identifier distinguishing this split bill on-chain.

merchantLockingScript.name: Merchant Locking Script
merchantLockingScript.description: Locking bytecode of the merchant or recipient who receives the settled bill.

merchantPayoutSatoshis.name: Merchant Payout Target
merchantPayoutSatoshis.description: Minimum net satoshis the merchant must receive upon settlement.

organizerKey.name: Organizer Key
organizerKey.description: Private key held by the bill organizer to authorize pre-full cancellation.

organizerPublicKey.name: Organizer Public Key
organizerPublicKey.description: Compressed 33-byte public key of the bill organizer.

initialDepositSatoshis.name: Initial Deposit
initialDepositSatoshis.description: Satoshis locked into the Bill Pot when opening the bill.

currentPotSatoshis.name: Current Pot Balance
currentPotSatoshis.description: Satoshis currently held in the Bill Pot UTXO being spent.

contributionSatoshis.name: Contribution Amount
contributionSatoshis.description: Additional satoshis a participant adds to the Bill Pot.

refundLockingScript.name: Refund Destination
refundLockingScript.description: Locking bytecode receiving reclaimed funds when an incomplete bill is cancelled.
